subject.title: feat: ask_user follow-ups — harness convergence, channel finalization + reactions, native cards, docked web panel

question: Should pre-existing paired operator tokens receive `operator.questions` through a compatibility migration, or should the clients require explicit re-pairing with a visible recovery path?
rationale: The feature needs question access on already-paired clients, but silently broadening a persisted operator token changes an authorization boundary; the repository policy requires maintainer intent for that contract.

options.title: Add explicit re-pair recovery
options.body: Keep existing stored grants unchanged and make the affected clients visibly guide users through re-pairing or refreshing permissions before showing question controls.

options.title: Migrate bounded operator grants
options.body: Explicitly upgrade existing eligible operator tokens to include the new scope, with migration tests and documented authorization rationale.

recommendation.title: Add explicit re-pair recovery
recommendation.body: Keep existing stored grants unchanged and make the affected clients visibly guide users through re-pairing or refreshing permissions before showing question controls.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant question runtime and paired-client integration history is concentrated in this contributor's merged and current work.
